payload.title: Verify bounded lexical captures are actual ranked prefixes before diagnosing omissions
payload.summary: Priority2 experiment-analysis integrity. experiments/retrieval_diagnostics/mechanics.py Mechanics validates scores, row-local order, rank coverage and complete positive membership only when complete_positive_universe=True. With False, an independently authored two-document actual native capture can be replaced by only its lower-scoring second row relabeled rank1; initialization accepts and calls the omitted higher-scoring row RESULT_BOUND_OMISSION. Thus captured rank and bound explanation are not authenticated against the omitted positive population. Existing native bounded consumers/tests imply top-K semantics, not arbitrary positive samples. Historical Case0009/0010 and sensitivity use complete captures, so no original verdict corruption is demonstrated.
payload.benefit: Acceptance: preserve frozen science. In a separately versioned future analysis adapter/verifier, distinguish a true bounded ranked prefix from an arbitrary partial sample. Validate omitted higher scores and stable equal-score corpus ordering from authenticated source/field statistics before certifying ranks or RESULT_BOUND_OMISSION, or explicitly report unverified prefix/unknown exclusion cause. Independently reject lower-ranked row relabeled1, a skipped middle row, wrong tied prefix, duplicate/missing ranks, inconsistent field/source and unsupported versions; accept genuine bounded prefixes, zero matches and complete unchanged captures. Test the actual from_rows/native adapter to diagnostic output; no gold or treatment rerun needed. Keep source authority and statistical provenance unchanged. Bounded maintenance-agent work after version/consumer approval.
payload.uncertainty: Original complete captures and published outcomes are unaffected by this counterexample. No production source-search ranker defect, agent effectiveness loss or publication bypass is inferred. Future verifier must state whether it recomputes rank-prefix mechanics or only authenticates external capture provenance; do not silently strengthen sealed implementations.
